trigger: 用户要求改变 TDD workflow 标题与节点展示

用户要求适用于所有 TDD 任务
alternatives: 仅修改当前 T-1
保留固定模板并在界面替换

trigger: 需要确定并行 T-1 与 T-2 的 workflow 展示

alternatives: 合并到单一 workflow
增加并行组父 workflow
action: 将独立 workflow 写入需求与设计约束

trigger: 用户要求两个直接审查角色不使用 workflow 且避免首行误判

直接 Agent 不提供 Schema 参数

alternatives: 保留 StructuredOutput workflow
扩展 Agent 运行时支持 Schema
提取自然语言中的 JSON

trigger: 需要为当前及未来需求持久记录 AI 与用户决定

basis: accepted 需求目录必须保持只读
pre-reviewer 可能在需求 accepted 后运行
用户要求规则适用于所有后续需求
alternatives: 每个需求目录内建立台账
把决定继续写入 requirements.md 或 tasks.md
action: 创建独立 AI 与用户 JSONL 台账并补录当前需求

trigger: T-6 启动后用户改变 Review 失败处理和决策记录要求
decision: 不以变更前 T-6 workflow 结果放行任务，也不启动 T-7/T-8；完成后只把可验证结果作为候选证据
basis: 原 workflow 在 Review 失败时直接停止
新需求要求三轮自动返修并在动作前记录决定
目标与验收标准已变化，需要重新授权和规划
alternatives: 继续按旧计划完成全部任务
丢弃所有 T-6 产生的有效证据
action: 暂停后续调度并回退需求状态进行增量规划

trigger: 用户要求三个审查角色发现非设计问题后直接修复
decision: 三个审查角色继续只读，由主 agent 记录归因并派发 test-engineer/impl-engineer 修复，再调用原角色重审
basis: 现行角色职责要求审查者只读
自动化不需要破坏职责隔离
修复仍应经过 TDD 和原门禁
alternatives: 允许审查角色直接写代码
由主 agent 无 TDD 地直接修改
action: 把只读审查与外部自动返修编排写入需求

trigger: 用户提出独立决策台账后询问 requirements 第 8 节是否仍需要
decision: 删除当前及未来 requirements 的决策记录章节，以两个 JSONL 台账作为唯一事实源
basis: 保留第 8 节会形成双重事实源
需求文档应只表达最终黑盒契约
用户台账可同时表达未决请求和已解决决定
alternatives: 第 8 节保留摘要
继续仅使用 requirements 决策表
action: 迁移当前决定并从需求文档删除第 8 节

trigger: 需要定义可记录的 AI 隐形决策边界
decision: 记录每个实际控制流程的决策摘要、依据、候选项、动作和结果，不记录私有思维链、秘密或无关原始日志
basis: 用户要求所有 AI 自动决定可审计
私有思维链不可作为交付物
流程分支和执行动作可以完整外显
alternatives: 记录模型完整内部推理
只记录最终 PASS/FAIL
action: 把可审计摘要边界写入需求与台账契约

trigger: T-6 Review 因调用方未提供实际 diff 或等效变更快照而返回 NO-GO
decision: 不修改测试或实现；先恢复可审计的实际变更快照与范围证明，再仅重跑 review-engineer
basis: Test 已形成可信 Red
Impl 已报告 16 pass / 0 fail
Review 唯一阻塞项是缺少 diff 证据而非需求或设计冲突
alternatives: 询问用户如何处理
重跑完整 Test/Impl
忽略证据直接放行
action: 从 workflow journal 和会话编辑记录重建 unified diff，核对实际文件范围后自动重审

trigger: 补齐 diff 前发现 AGENTS.md 在 T-6 workflow 结束后被外部改写，文件时间晚于 workflow 实现且正式验证变为 10 pass / 6 fail
decision: 停止基于旧快照的 T-6 重审，不恢复旧范围成品；保留仍可核验的测试和 spec-flow 改动作为候选证据，按新需求对当前真实工作区重新增量规划
basis: 当前 AGENTS.md 已缺失 TDD 全局门禁段
旧 Review 所依据的 16 pass 快照已失效
用户已授权新自动返修与决策台账需求的增量规划
alternatives: 无视漂移继续重审
立即恢复旧 T-6 AGENTS 文本
丢弃全部候选改动
action: 清理未完成的临时 diff 证据并启动 planner 读取当前工作区

trigger: 用户指出决策记录应跟随需求而不是混在全局台账
decision: 接受按需求聚合的方向；由于需求目录自包含与 accepted 后不可变约束存在取舍，先记录用户决策请求再确定最终落点
basis: 按需求聚合能让审阅、迁移和归档自包含
当前全局文件会混杂不同需求
把台账放进 accepted 目录需要定义追加例外
alternatives: 需求目录内追加式台账
独立 decisions/<slug> 分区
继续全局混合台账
action: 请求用户决定台账物理归属与 accepted 后追加边界

trigger: 用户选择每个需求目录内保存两个决策台账
decision: 把需求目录定义为决策聚合边界；accepted 后仅两个台账允许追加，其他契约和交付文件保持不可修改；现有全局台账迁入当前需求后删除
basis: 用户明确选择需求目录内方案
需求包需要自包含
post-accept pre-review 决策仍需要追加位置
alternatives: 保留全局台账作为索引
在全局与需求目录双写
迁到独立 decisions/<slug>
action: 记录迁移授权请求；批准后修订需求、迁移台账并重跑 planner

trigger: 主 agent 审核 planner 产物时发现 T-8 与 T-9 同依赖 T-7、文件集不相交，但都标记 parallel false
decision: 把 T-8 与 T-9 修正为 T-7 完成后的同一并行组，保持各自独立任务与验证
basis: T-8 只触碰 acceptance/spec-flow 文件
T-9 只触碰 pre-review/git-push 文件
用户已确认尽可能自动化且 tasks 允许文件不相交任务并行
alternatives: 保持串行
合并 T-8/T-9 为一个任务
action: 让 planner 仅修订 design/tasks 的 parallel 标志与调度说明

trigger: 用户指出 decision-requested 与 execution-authorized 记录包含重复问题和选项
decision: 保留请求与解决两个追加事件，但正式解决事件只保存 resolves、selected、impact 和状态，不重复 question/options
basis: 请求事件必须在回答前持久化以支持失败关闭和恢复
解决事件可通过 resolves 关联原问题
减少重复字段不会改变外部行为或审计能力
alternatives: 合并为可变单记录
继续在解决事件复制全部问题和选项
action: 在 T-6 测试与实现中采用规范化请求/解决事件格式；既有行保持不可改写

trigger: 用户采用决策工具与 tool_call hook，并要求现有台账迁移为一项决定一行
decision: 暂停旧 T-6，在启用严格 append 前一次性规范化两个台账；新增 Pi extension 的 decision_record 工具与 tool_call 写门禁，并让可写子 Agent 加载扩展
basis: 当前没有 hook 或 decision-ledger 工具
Pi tool_call 事件可在执行前阻断工具
test-engineer 与 impl-engineer 当前 extensions:false，单靠主会话 hook 无法覆盖子 Agent 写操作
alternatives: 继续只依赖提示词与 CLI
只保护主 agent 写操作
修改 Pi 核心
action: 修订需求与规划，扩大 T-6/T-7 文件范围并重新申请实施授权

trigger: 用户批准实施材料性决策规则与 hook 门禁
decision: 先将需求回退到 confirmed，建立迁移快照并按材料性判定规范化现有台账，再修订 R/AC 和重新规划；旧 T-6 before 快照作废清理
basis: 新增 hook 和子 Agent 扩展加载改变生产文件范围
当前台账含纯请求与机械调度记录
现有 T-6 尚未启动 Agent，可无损重置
alternatives: 直接在旧计划上实现
只新增提示词不改 hook
保留混合格式台账
action: 执行一次性台账迁移、requirements lint、planner 增量规划和最终范围核对

trigger: T-6 Review 指出 tasks refs 把 R-21、AC-16、AC-18、AC-23 的 permit/交互场景错误归给 canonical writer 任务
decision: 把 T-6 收窄为 canonical writer、六文件、严格追加、accepted 冻结和迁移验证；permit/hook、多次机械动作、忽略问题与跨需求行为留给已规划的 T-7/T-9，再仅重跑 T-6 Review
basis: T-6 生产文件不包含 extension 或 spec-flow
decision-ledger writer 不实现 permit
当前生产实现与正式 verify 已通过，唯一阻塞是任务追踪范围不一致
alternatives: 把 permit 功能提前塞入 T-6
重跑完整 Test/Impl
询问用户修改需求
action: 由 planner 窄幅修订 design/tasks refs 和测试策略，不修改 T-6 生产/测试文件；提供现有实际 diff 后重审

trigger: T-7 Review found arbitrary non-verify command permits, symlink TOCTOU in guarded writes, and incomplete AC-18 dual-actor isolation coverage
decision: Restrict command permits to the exact tasks.verify bytes and cwd; block raw built-in edit/write and require guarded decision_edit/write to revalidate canonical path and reject symlinks at mutation time under the permit lock; add dual AI/user and second-requirement zero-change tests, then rerun Test/Impl/Review
basis: The design binds command hashes to tasks.verify
Preflight-only canonicalization cannot protect the later custom write from a symlink swap
AC-18 requires both actors and requirement isolation
alternatives: Allow arbitrary caller-supplied command hashes
Keep raw built-in edit/write after preflight
Ask the user to weaken the security boundary
action: Create a round-1 snapshot, add failing regression tests, minimally repair decision-gate policy/index, regenerate actual diff, and rerun independent review

trigger: T-7 round-1 Review found hard-link replacement escape, untested intermediate symlink and failed-consumption invariants, non-production-like cross-requirement fixtures, and an unused stat import
decision: Bind existing targets and every parent component to expected dev/ino identity at permit issue, reject symlinks and multi-link files, revalidate identity immediately before guarded mutation; make guarded permit consumption transactional so failed path checks append no consumption; rebuild AC-18 with two slugs under one repo root and remove the unused import
basis: Hard links preserve pathname realpath and bypass final O_NOFOLLOW
Intermediate component identity must be checked separately from the leaf
A blocked mutation must not spend a permit use
Requirement isolation is defined within one repository requirements root
alternatives: Accept the external race as out of scope
Disable guarded edit/write entirely
Add a native openat dependency
action: Create round-2 snapshot, add hard-link/intermediate-symlink/consumption/same-root regressions, minimally repair policy/index, regenerate actual diff, and rerun independent review

trigger: T-7 round-2 Review found final-check-to-write rename TOCTOU, post-mutation consumption commit reuse, missing nlink=1 inode/create regressions, and missing round-2 after evidence
decision: Replace in-place FD mutation with verified same-directory temporary-file write plus atomic path replacement so a renamed original inode is never modified; persist and spend a permit reservation before mutation, then commit after success so commit failure cannot reuse the same use; add regular inode replacement and create-target insertion regressions, and split final Review until main independently verifies after/diff evidence
basis: An open handle follows an inode after rename
A durable pre-mutation reservation prevents maxUses replay when post-mutation commit fails
nlink-only tests do not prove dev/ino binding
Review evidence must be generated and independently checked before reviewer dispatch
alternatives: Accept rename races as an external-process limitation
Mutate the opened inode and attempt post-write rollback
Add native openat/renameat dependency
action: Run round-3 Test/Impl, independently generate and verify after snapshots/diff, then run a separate structured Review; stop as technical-blocked if it still fails

trigger: T-7 exhausted three repair rounds and the auto-discovered decision-gate extension still has Review-confirmed security blockers
decision: Restore all T-7 files to their pre-task absent state so a failed security gate cannot auto-load on reload or a new session; preserve workflow journals and the failed task note as evidence
basis: T-7 round-0 before manifest recorded all three files absent
Global extensions auto-load after reload/new session
Keeping a known-unsafe enforcement extension is a higher risk than removing the failed partial implementation
alternatives: Keep unsafe files for debugging
Rename them to a disabled legacy location
Continue a fourth unapproved repair round
action: Delete the T-7 test, index, and policy files, remove empty directories, verify absence, and leave T-8 onward unstarted

trigger: User authorized continuation after three failed in-process pathname-based repair rounds; platform research confirmed Python dir_fd and no-follow primitives are available
decision: Replace the in-process pathname mutation path with a bundled Python two-phase mutation helper: helper anchors each directory via no-follow dir FDs, validates/stages and emits PREPARED, Node durably reserves the permit use, then helper COMMIT performs one dir-fd-relative rename/link and fsync; missing helper/Python/protocol failure is fail closed with no legacy fallback
basis: Python 3.14 exposes os.open dir_fd, os.rename src_dir_fd/dst_dir_fd, os.link/unlink dir_fd, O_NOFOLLOW and O_DIRECTORY on the target macOS environment
A long-lived helper can hold validated directory/file descriptors across the reservation boundary
Separating PREPARED from COMMIT ensures validation failure does not consume and commit failure cannot replay
The previous Node pathname implementation was rolled back and is absent
alternatives: Add a native Node addon
Weaken the external rename threat model
Attempt a fourth pathname-only patch
action: Replan T-7 to add the helper and protocol tests, reset the failed task, then run a fresh TDD task with end-to-end decision_record failure coverage

trigger: Python dir-fd T-7 Review found PREPARED transport not closed before reservation, incomplete staging cleanup state, spoofable role/child attach, and non-end-to-end writer failure tests
decision: Use separate one-shot PREPARED and COMMITTED response pipes with PREPARE-channel and stderr EOF required before reservation; persist full staging/chain identity in reservation and implement exact CLEANUP recovery; bind role to the manager-assigned Pi session name set before extension session_start plus child invocation hash; inject real T-6 writer open/sync failures in end-to-end extension tests
basis: pi-subagents sets the manager-assigned role#agentId session name before bindExtensions/session_start
A response pipe that reaches EOF is the only way to prove no extra PREPARED-stage output before reservation while keeping the helper alive for COMMIT
Recovery cannot safely clean staging without parent chain, staged identity, and content digest in the durable reservation
chmod preflight does not exercise append or fsync failure
alternatives: Trust helper output after first line
Trust caller-provided role
Omit cleanup recovery
Treat writer preflight failure as sufficient AC-19 evidence
action: Create new-architecture round-1 snapshot, add protocol/cleanup/role/real-writer failure Red tests, minimally repair helper/policy/index, independently generate evidence, and rerun Review

trigger: User prohibited adding Python while requiring an installable Pi package and a decision-gate hook
decision: Use a pure TypeScript/Node decision-gate that serializes all Pi-controlled mutations through guarded custom tools, blocks raw mutation tools, validates path identity immediately before an atomic temporary-file replacement, and treats concurrent filesystem changes by processes outside Pi as explicitly outside the hook security boundary; no native helper or fallback
basis: Pi tool_call hook can block all model-controlled raw writes and writable execution chains
withFileMutationQueue and requirement locks serialize in-scope Pi mutations
The confirmed boundary already states user_bash and external processes are outside the hook control plane
A native addon or standalone helper would introduce another platform/toolchain dependency similar to the rejected Python concern
alternatives: Ship a native C/Rust helper
Require Python
Claim syscall-level protection against external adversarial processes using path-only Node APIs
action: Rollback all current T-7 artifacts, revise design and tests to the explicit Pi-controlled threat model, and replan a Node-only T-7 from an absent baseline

trigger: Pure Node T-7 Review found name-only pre-ready read bypass, permits not bound to task files, non-exact verify commands, unusable/spoofable child launcher bindings, and non-real package loading evidence
decision: Require exact built-in provenance even before ready; derive permit paths strictly from tasks.files and bash commands from exact tasks.verify bytes; allow Agent/SubagentWorkflow only when active permit matches the complete launcher input hash, inject a one-time child nonce into the launch context, and bind attach to the manager-assigned role#agentId session identity plus that invocation hash; replace direct-import package test with actual Pi resource-loader loading; close materiality schema
basis: Tool names alone are not provenance
Task files and verify are the approved execution boundary
A child id is assigned after launch, so a one-time nonce plus trusted manager session identity is needed instead of caller self-report
Package readiness must exercise installed relative resources
alternatives: Keep all launcher calls blocked
Trust caller-provided child session names
Permit verify prefixes
Treat a direct import as package installation
action: Narrowly update design child binding, add failing regression/integration tests, minimally repair index/policy, regenerate evidence, and rerun Review

trigger: Pure Node T-7 round-2 Review found pi.exec cannot execute literal verify bytes with env assignment, legacy permit schema remains reachable, child pending lacks exact manager session finalization, and SubagentWorkflow has no positive launch evidence
decision: Compile the exact tasks.verify bytes with a closed no-shell argv/env grammar and execute via pi.exec(executable,args,{cwd,env}); replace permit input with a strict discriminated schema and delete every legacy branch; finalize pending Agent/Workflow identity in a parent tool_result hook using the actual returned id before child attach, then bind the exact manager session and one-time nonce; add positive SubagentWorkflow grant/envelope/finalization tests and remove the unused test import
basis: pi.exec expects executable and argv rather than a complete shell command string
No-legacy requirements require deleting rather than hiding compatibility branches
The parent tool result is the first trusted point containing the manager-assigned id
Workflow launcher policy needs an executable positive path distinct from internal child integration deferred to T-9
alternatives: Use a shell to execute verify
Keep legacy permit fields but reject most combinations
Allow same-role arbitrary session with a secret token
Keep all Workflow launches blocked
action: Update child-handshake design, add final-round Red tests, minimally repair index/policy, regenerate evidence, and run the final independent Review

trigger: Pure Node T-7 exhausted three Review repair rounds and final Review still found an unusable public permit schema, hidden attach shape, incomplete receipt binding, missing exact real verify evidence, and contract drift
decision: Stop T-7 and restore its auto-discovered extension and test files to the pre-task absent baseline so a non-GO enforcement extension cannot load in later sessions; preserve canonical writer, decision ledgers, workflow journals, migration evidence, and failed task diagnostics
basis: The extension remains a security gate and cannot ship with known authorization-interface defects
T-7 node-round-0 before proves all three task files were absent
T-8 and later depend on T-7 GO and must remain unstarted
alternatives: Keep unsafe extension files for debugging
Rename to a disabled legacy path
Start an unapproved fourth automatic repair round
action: Delete T-7 test/index/policy, remove T-7 snapshots and empty extension directory, mark T-7 failed/review, and stop scheduling
